hapticOnComplete.title: Haptic when complete
hapticOnComplete.hint: A strong vibration when a dhikr's count reaches zero

hapticOnTap.title: Haptic on every tap
hapticOnTap.hint: A light tick each time you tap a card

hideCompleted.title: Hide completed cards
hideCompleted.hint: A card fades away once its count reaches zero

progress.title: Reset all counters?
progress.message: All of today's adhkar counters will go back to zero. This can't be undone.

cache.title: Clear the cache?
cache.message: Saved search results and prayer times will be deleted and reloaded when needed. Your favorites and settings won't change.

settings.title: Restore default settings?
settings.message: Theme, text size, reading options and adhan reminders go back to their defaults. Your favorites and counters won't change.

all.title: Delete all app data?
all.message: Favorites, counters, settings and cache will all be deleted, as if the app were freshly installed. This can't be undone.

soundHints.custom: Pick an audio file from your device
soundHints.customNotice: Plays in the app; notifications use the default adhan

hanafiAsr.title: Hanafi Asr
hanafiAsr.hint: Asr starts later, when an object's shadow is twice its length
